messages:
Ava M: Quick sync — tech run for Apr 15 panel at 10:00am PT. Can everyone confirm availability? We need panelist mics, live captions, cloud recording + auto transcript, and HubSpot lead tag flow.
Jordan K: I can do 10am. I'll be host for Zoom, will pre-assign co-hosts (Priya/Sam).
Priya S: Confirmed. What's the transcript vendor for verbatim SRTs — Otter or Rev?
Liam R: Rev for verbatim SRTs + speaker timestamps. Otter is fine for live captions during the session.
Ava M: Ok — plan: Otter live captions for accessibility, Rev for post-event SRT + verbatim transcript. @Jordan K please enable Live Transcription and set Otter as the provider in Zoom settings, and pre-assign Priya/Sam as co-hosts.
Jordan K: On it. Quick Zoom checklist: cloud recording = ON, record separate audio for each participant = ON, add cloud transcription = ON, enable alternative hosts. Any reason to prefer local recording?
Priya S: Use cloud. We need the recording to auto-ingest to S3 for processing; local recordings complicate upload.
Liam R: For S3 ingest use the recordings-ingest webhook -> recordings-bucket. I'll provision the IAM role and posthook.
Ava M: Post-event deliverables: (1) Rev transcript + SRT (verbatim), (2) 10-min highlight edit, (3) three 60s social clips with burned-in captions, (4) HubSpot mapping: campaign = "panel-apr15", tag = "event:panel-apr15", lead score +60.
Jordan K: Here's the run-of-show I'll use for Zoom spotlight timestamps:
```
00:00-00:05 Welcome + host intro
00:05-00:15 Opening remarks (speaker)
00:15-00:45 Panel discussion (moderated)
00:45-00:55 Live Q&A
00:55-01:00 CTA & close
```
Priya S: I'll send panelist prep email today — ask them to join 20 minutes early for mic checks, upload slides to Drive by Apr 10, and provide a 1-paragraph bio.
Sam V: Video team will handle highlight edit + three clips. Need Rev SRT and speaker timestamps within 6 hours of upload, otherwise we can't turn around clips same day.
Ava M: Who owns post-event email? I can draft copy. Jordan — can you wire the automation to send recording at 6 hours and a nurture drip at day 3 and day 7? Also map form fields -> HubSpot contact properties.
Jordan K: Yep. Automation plan: send recording at ~6h (if Rev job complete), otherwise send raw cloud recording + update when final asset ready. Drip sequence: Day 3: product use cases; Day 7: demo CTA. Lead routing: MQLs -> AE queue; others -> nurture.
rev-bot: Rev job queued: https://rev.co/jobs/abc123 (ETA ~4 hours after zoom upload)
Liam R: Reminder: set Zoom meeting to "Mute participants on entry" and use Waiting Room for early joiners. Also enable "record active speaker with shared screen" so separate tracks behave predictably.
Ava M: Also add meta: tag recording in S3 with metadata {"campaign":"panel-apr15","event_date":"2025-04-15"} so downstream pipelines can pick it up.
Priya S: I'll cc panelists and include an internal note: join 9:40am PT for tech check, bring wired headphones if possible.
Sam V: Drive folder for uploads & deliverables: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/xxxxx — I'll drop asset naming convention: panel-apr15_raw.mp4, panel-apr15_rev.srt, panel-apr15_10min_edit.mp4, panel-apr15_clip1_60s.mp4, etc.
Jordan K: I'll post the test meeting link in #marketing 24h before and again 1 hour before.
Ava M: Action owners: Jordan (Zoom + HubSpot automations + meeting link), Priya (panelist comms), Liam (webhook + S3 + IAM), Sam (video edits + clips), Ava (email copy + asset list). Tech check Apr 15 9:40am PT. :thumbsup: 
Jordan K: Confirmed. If Rev delays, fallback plan is send raw cloud recording + add a second email when Rev assets arrive.
Priya S: Noted. I'll include transcript expectations in the prep note so panelists know turnaround.
Ava M: Great — closing thread. If anyone can't make the 9:40 tech check speak now.
